data.notes: The report gets the core diagnosis right. It tags Value proof, says 'lost on price' describes the controller's rate-only page rather than the cause, and builds its messaging around a one-page business case in Fernbrook's own numbers. It misses some key evidence. It never cites Sam's 'If we'd had more room on the rate, we win this' as labeled opinion. It labels the bank's 'no new product, just a better rate' as opinion when the key treats it as fact per Lucy. The trigger insight leaves out that the pain was owned by someone who couldn't sign. The close does not name 'what the failed orders were worth' as an open question, and it does not recommend offering the decline analysis ahead of spring. There are also several speaker misattributions: Sam's lines are credited to Lucy and Farah.
